abilities.description: After assigning all your starting stats, add +1 to Wits. If you ever must uncover some important piece of knowledge from studying, or must recall something that you would’ve learned about in history classes, add +1.

Underwater breathing: You may breathe underwater without ever having to surface for air, and when you must do combat underwater against a single foe who cannot breathe underwater, you are ALWAYS considered to be In Control. You may also start with either the @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedassets.Item.dabb03f5d0a167f0]{Leader} asset or the @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedassets.Item.bcc219b0ebfb5c68]{Diplomat} asset for free (you still get your usual starting assets).
